name: seo-structured-data
description: Use when the user asks to add JSON-LD structured data, schema.org markup, rich results, Product, Article, BreadcrumbList or Organization schema, review stars, or Rich Results Test errors. Produces valid, XSS-safe JSON-LD rendered server-side and validated in CI. Not for meta tags and Open Graph (use frontend-seo) or crawl issues (use seo-fundamentals).
